DeepSeek-V4 Indexer Top-K — Single-Operator EvaluationDeepSeek-V4 Indexer Top-K —— 单算子评测

Apples-to-apples comparison of 11 indexer top-K operators extracted from TensorRT-LLM and benchmarked standalone (the 11th, SGLang StreamingTopK, is the external cross-reference — see the algorithmic comparison card below). Primary objective: speedup of GVR top-K vs the other operators. Timing = nsys pure-kernel GPU time (per-cell NVTX range, kernel time summed from nvtx_kern_sum; the L2-evict kernel is excluded). This supersedes the earlier CUDA-event timing (which over-charged by the graph-launch + single-replay overhead, ~11%); every cell here is the true kernel GPU time. Two L2 regimes: cold-L2 (512 MB flush before each launch — canonical, isolated worst case) and warm-L2 (logits hot in L2 — models the fused indexer→top-K path). This report adds a hardware dimension: the identical sweep is run on B300 (sm_103) and B200 (sm_100); use the view selector below for a single machine or a compare overlay (B300 solid, B200 dashed). Three later optimization ops — #17 threshold-portfolio, #18 multi-threshold and #19 sandwich two-threshold — are additionally overlaid as anchored series (per-cell op/base ratio from their in-bucket A/B, transferred onto this report's nsys gvr_cutedsl axis; coverage & method in the methodology card below).

对从 TensorRT-LLM 中抽取并独立基准测试的 11 个 indexer top-K 算子做同口径对比（第 11 个 SGLang StreamingTopK 是外部交叉参考 —— 见下方算法对比卡片）。首要目标：GVR top-K 相对其他算子的加速比。计时 = nsys 纯 kernel GPU 时间（按 cell 的 NVTX 区间，从 nvtx_kern_sum 求和 kernel 时间；L2 清空 kernel 已排除）。这取代了早前的 CUDA-event 计时（后者因 graph 启动 + 单次 replay 开销高估约 11%）；此处每个 cell 都是真实 kernel GPU 时间。两种 L2 状态：冷 L2（每次启动前清空 512 MB —— 规范化、隔离的最坏情况）与 热 L2（logits 驻留 L2 —— 模拟融合 indexer→top-K 路径）。本报告还增加了硬件维度：相同 sweep 同时在 B300(sm_103) 与 B200(sm_100) 上运行；用下方 view 选择器查看单机或 compare 叠加（B300 实线，B200 虚线）。另外叠加了三个后续优化算子 —— #17 threshold-portfolio、#18 multi-threshold、#19 sandwich two-threshold —— 作为锚定序列（用各自 bucket 内 A/B 的按-cell op/base 比值，迁移到本报告的 nsys gvr_cutedsl 刻度上；覆盖范围与方法见下方方法学卡片）。

The 10 in-tree ops compute exact top-K across all dtypes×K — they solve the same problem and are directly interchangeable. SGLang StreamingTopK is also exact but only over its faithful envelope (fp32, K≤1024); it is included as an external reference kernel, not an interchangeable in-tree path. GVR is a threshold-based exact selector: the pre_idx hint only seeds its Phase-2 threshold search (Guess); the full-N Verify/Refine phases guarantee correctness regardless of hint quality (a hit-rate of 0 only adds secant iterations, not error). All ops consume identical logits / pre_idx per cell. Correctness vs torch.topk = value-equivalence (vdiff=0); CUDA-op parity vs in-tree ≤3%. Input generation detailed below.

Anchored overlays (ops #17/#18/#19): these three ops were benchmarked in their own buckets as back-to-back A/Bs against the same single-CTA gvr_cutedsl baseline, on the same synthetic report bundles (seed=42, hit-rate 0.6), with CUDA-graph + cudaEvent cold-L2 timing. Their curves here are ratio-transferred: per cell, µs = (this report's nsys gvr_cutedsl µs) × (op/base event ratio measured in-run). This preserves each op's measured relative speedup exactly while placing it on the common nsys absolute axis (spot cells were independently nsys-validated in each bucket: op#17 1.21–1.67×, op#18 1.10–1.45×, op#19 fp32 8/8 + 16-bit 6/6 positive). Coverage limits: op#18/#19 are B200 + cold-L2 only (gaps in the warm view / B300 view); op#18 has BS>1 only at (K512, fp32, N65536).

10 个树内算子在全部 dtype×K 下都计算精确 top-K —— 它们解决同一问题，可直接互换。SGLang StreamingTopK 同样精确，但仅在其忠实范围内（fp32，K≤1024）；它作为外部参考 kernel 纳入，并非可互换的树内路径。GVR 是基于阈值的精确选择器：pre_idx 提示只为其 Phase-2 阈值搜索（Guess）提供种子；全 N 的 Verify/Refine 阶段无论提示质量如何都保证正确性（命中率为 0 只增加割线迭代，不产生误差）。所有算子每个 cell 消费完全相同的 logits / pre_idx。相对 torch.topk 的正确性 = 值等价（vdiff=0）；CUDA-op 与树内算子的一致性 ≤3%。输入生成见下文。

锚定叠加算子（op#17/#18/#19）：这三个算子在各自 bucket 内与同一个单 CTA gvr_cutedsl 基准做背靠背 A/B，使用相同的合成 report 数据包（seed=42，命中率 0.6）、CUDA-graph + cudaEvent 冷 L2 计时。此处曲线为比值迁移：每个 cell 的 µs =（本报告 nsys gvr_cutedsl µs）×（bucket 内实测的 op/base event 比值）。这在保持各算子实测相对加速比不变的前提下，将其放到统一的 nsys 绝对刻度上（各 bucket 均有独立 nsys 抽查验证：op#17 1.21–1.67×，op#18 1.10–1.45×，op#19 fp32 8/8 + 16-bit 6/6 正收益成立）。覆盖范围限制：op#18/#19 仅 B200 + 冷 L2（热 L2 视图 / B300 视图中为空缺）；op#18 的 BS>1 数据仅在 (K512, fp32, N65536)。

Algorithmic comparison — SGLang StreamingTopK vs the in-tree families (B300 cold-L2; B200 hardware-invariant)算法对比 —— SGLang StreamingTopK vs 树内算子族（B300 冷 L2；B200 硬件无关）

SGLang's device::top512::StreamingTopK<K> is a single-CTA-per-row, TMA double-buffered streaming bucket-select: stream the row once through a 4096-bin fp16 coarse histogram, walk bins high→low to find the rank-K boundary bin, then do an exact 4-round 8-bit radix refine on the ≤kMaxTies=1024 boundary candidates. It is exact and hint-free — unlike GVR it needs no pre_idx and has no threshold-search convergence behaviour; unlike radix-single-CTA it streams, so it has no smem-capacity ceiling. Constraints: fp32-only (TMA float) and K≤1024 (the tie buffer is sized kMaxTies=kMaxTopK=1024).

How it maps onto the report's three algorithm families

vs familyStreamingTopK advantageStreamingTopK disadvantage
GVR (CUDA / cuteDSL / rank-scatter / cluster / op#8)Hint-free & unconditionally exact: no pre_idx to build/propagate, no secant iteration count or P3 over-collect, no real-data undershoot risk. Simpler launch, fewer phases.GVR's pre_idx lets it skip most of N (scan only a candidate band), so at long context GVR pays far less than a full single-CTA stream of all N.
Radix single-CTA (CUDA / cuteDSL-single)No smem ceiling — StreamingTopK runs the entire N grid (radix-single dies above ~57K fp32 / one CTA's smem). TMA streaming hides memory latency that the smem-resident radix cannot once the row no longer fits.When the row does fit one CTA's smem (small N), radix-single is the leanest path and edges StreamingTopK out (it never re-reads from global).
Radix multi-CTA (CUDA / cuteDSL-multi) & GVR cluster/op#8Far lower fixed overhead at small N and much better BS scaling — one lean CTA/row vs a multi-CTA global-histogram merge / cluster barrier per row.At long context + low BS the multi-CTA kernels split one row across many CTAs and stay ~flat in N, while StreamingTopK's lone CTA streams serially and grows ~linearly with N — so they overtake it once one CTA can no longer hide the stream.

Verdict

  • Sweet spot: small–to–medium N (≤~65K) and high batch — there StreamingTopK is the fastest or co-fastest kernel measured (on B300 it is the fastest even at the shortest N=4K/BS=1 cell, edging out the smem-resident radix-single), and it does it without a pre_idx hint, which is its key structural advantage over GVR.
  • Where it loses: long context at low BS (N≥128K, BS=1). GVR's hint lets it skip most of N (rank-scatter P4 = 39.8µs vs 80.4µs at 256K), and multi-CTA radix / GVR cluster split the row across SMs and stay flat — the lone streaming CTA cannot.
  • Envelope limits: fp32-only and K≤1024 — so it is not applicable to the V3.2 K=2048 real-data comparison (and is non-exact if forced there), and cannot serve the bf16/fp16 cells the in-tree ops cover.
  • Net: an excellent hint-free, exact, no-smem-cap reference that validates the in-tree kernels in the short/mid/high-BS regime, but the production GVR path retains a real long-context edge precisely because it exploits pre_idx temporal locality.

Numbers are this-B300 cold-L2 medians (same synthetic bundles, seed=42, unified preIdx hit-rate 0.6, same prebuilt SASS as B200; op is set-exact 512/512 & 1024/1024 on sm_103). The identical B200 sweep reproduces every cell within ~3% — the GVR(CUDA)-vs-SGLang verdict is hardware-invariant (0.84× median on both; SGLang faster in 138/182 B300, 139/182 B200 cells). Toggle SGLang StreamingTopK in the operator selector below to overlay its latency/speedup curves on every chart.

SGLang 的 device::top512::StreamingTopK<K> 是一个每行单 CTA、TMA 双缓冲流式桶选择：将整行流式经过一个 4096 桶的 fp16 粗直方图，从高到低遍历桶找到第 K 名的边界桶，再对 ≤kMaxTies=1024 个边界候选做精确的 4 轮 8 位 radix 细化。它精确且无需提示 —— 与 GVR 不同，它不需要 pre_idx，没有阈值搜索收敛行为；与 radix-single-CTA 不同，它是流式的，所以没有 smem 容量上限。约束：仅 fp32（TMA float）与 K≤1024（tie 缓冲区大小为 kMaxTies=kMaxTopK=1024）。

它如何映射到报告的三个算法族

对比族StreamingTopK 优势StreamingTopK 劣势
GVR（CUDA / cuteDSL / rank-scatter / cluster / op#8）无提示且无条件精确：无需构造/传播 pre_idx，没有割线迭代次数或 P3 过采集，没有真实数据欠采风险。启动更简单、阶段更少。GVR 的 pre_idx 让它能跳过大部分 N（只扫描候选带），故在长上下文下 GVR 远比对全 N 做单 CTA 流式便宜。
Radix single-CTA（CUDA / cuteDSL-single）无 smem 上限 —— StreamingTopK 可跑整个 N 网格（radix-single 在约 57K fp32 / 单 CTA smem 以上崩溃）。TMA 流式隐藏了行不再放得下时 smem 驻留 radix 无法隐藏的访存延迟。当行确实能放进单 CTA smem（小 N）时，radix-single 是最精简路径，险胜 StreamingTopK（它从不重读全局）。
Radix multi-CTA（CUDA / cuteDSL-multi）与 GVR cluster/op#8小 N 时固定开销低得多，BS 扩展性也好得多 —— 每行一个精简 CTA，相对每行的多 CTA 全局直方图归并 / cluster 屏障。在长上下文 + 低 BS 下，多 CTA kernel 把一行拆到许多 CTA 上、随 N 近似持平，而 StreamingTopK 的单 CTA 串行流式随 N 近线性增长 —— 故当单 CTA 不再能隐藏流式时它们会反超。

结论

  • 最佳区间：中小 N（≤约 65K）与高批 —— 此处 StreamingTopK 是实测最快或并列最快的 kernel（在 B300 上即便最短的 N=4K/BS=1 cell 它也最快，险胜 smem 驻留的 radix-single），而且不需要 pre_idx 提示，这是它相对 GVR 的关键结构优势。
  • 落败之处：低 BS 的长上下文（N≥128K，BS=1）。GVR 的提示让它跳过大部分 N（rank-scatter P4 在 256K 为 39.8µs vs 80.4µs），多 CTA radix / GVR cluster 把行拆到各 SM 上保持持平 ——单个流式 CTA 做不到。
  • 范围限制：仅 fp32 且 K≤1024 —— 故不适用于 V3.2 K=2048 真实数据对比（强行使用则非精确），也无法服务树内算子覆盖的 bf16/fp16 cell。
  • 总体：一个优秀的无提示、精确、无 smem 上限参考，在短/中/高 BS 区间验证了树内 kernel，但生产 GVR 路径在长上下文仍保有真实优势，正因为它利用了 pre_idx 时间局部性。

数字为本 B300 冷 L2 中位（相同合成 bundle，seed=42，统一 preIdx 命中率 0.6，与 B200 相同的预编译 SASS；该算子在 sm_103 上集合精确 512/512 与 1024/1024）。完全相同的 B200 sweep 在约 3% 内复现每个 cell —— GVR(CUDA) 对 SGLang 的结论硬件无关（两机中位均 0.84×；SGLang 更快的 cell 数：B300 138/182，B200 139/182）。点选下方算子选择器中的 SGLang StreamingTopK 可在每张图上叠加其延迟/加速比曲线。

Synthetic input generation (random data characteristics)合成输入生成（随机数据特征）

Inputs are not uniform random — they reproduce the statistics of real DeepSeek-V4 indexer captures so that the GVR path (whose Phase-2 threshold search is seeded by temporal locality via pre_idx — exact output) is exercised realistically. One bundle per (K, dtype, N): logits[1, N] + pre_idx[1, K], then replicated across BS rows (no VarLen) so every op sees the same data.

Kgenerator skillcompress_ratiofit sourcepre_idx hit-rate (preIdx∩topK)
512swebench-temporal-synth-v4flash4real V4-Flash swe-bench 64K B300 captures — 21 GVR-active layers (even 2..42)0.60 (vertical)
1024swebench-temporal-synth-v4pro4real V4-Pro swe-bench 64K B300 captures — 30 GVR-active layers (even 2..60)0.60 (vertical)
2048swebench-temporal-synth (true V3.2, cr=1)1real SWE-Bench L20/L22/L42 beta fits0.60 (diagonal)

logits distribution: temporally-coherent values drawn from 3 fitted Beta distributions (shallow / moderate / deep buckets by layer-mean magnitude); this sweep uses the moderate bucket (cfg=beta_moderate) across all cells, in fp32/bf16/fp16.
pre_idx (temporal hint, required by GVR): the prev-step top-K, built as Gaussian noise + a binary-searched coefficient calibrated to a unified realised hit-rate of 0.6 for every K / dtype / N (synth_data.TARGET_HR=0.6, overriding each skill's per-cfg default). Propagation depends on compress_ratio: vertical for K=512/1024 (cr=4 — caller stores prev_topk, kernel offset 0) and diagonal for K=2048 (cr=1 — caller stores prev_topk−1, kernel preIdxOffset=+1 ⇒ net read = prev_topk). The radix ops ignore pre_idx and reach exact top-K by per-bit histogram select; GVR also returns exact top-K and uses pre_idx only to seed its threshold search.
compress_ratio convention: radix_cutedsl takes seq_lens=N; all other ops take seq_lens=N×cr (kernel recomputes N=kv_len/cr).
Determinism: fixed seed=42 per (K, dtype, N) — fully reproducible; N grid 4K..256K (cells with N>2K only). The same bundles are used on every machine, so the B300/B200 comparison isolates hardware.

输入不是均匀随机 —— 它们复现真实 DeepSeek-V4 indexer 捕获的统计特征，使 GVR 路径（其 Phase-2 阈值搜索由 pre_idx 的时间局部性提供种子 —— 输出精确）得到真实测试。每个 (K, dtype, N) 一个 bundle：logits[1, N] + pre_idx[1, K]，再跨 BS 行复制（无 VarLen），使每个算子看到相同数据。

K生成器 skillcompress_ratio拟合来源pre_idx 命中率 (preIdx∩topK)
512swebench-temporal-synth-v4flash4真实 V4-Flash swe-bench 64K B300 captures —— 21 个 GVR 活跃层（偶数 2..42）0.60（纵向）
1024swebench-temporal-synth-v4pro4真实 V4-Pro swe-bench 64K B300 captures —— 30 个 GVR 活跃层（偶数 2..60）0.60（纵向）
2048swebench-temporal-synth（真 V3.2，cr=1）1真实 SWE-Bench L20/L22/L42 beta 拟合0.60（对角）

logits 分布：时间相干的值，取自 3 个拟合的 Beta 分布（按层均值大小分为 shallow / moderate / deep 三档）；本 sweep 所有 cell 都用 moderate 档（cfg=beta_moderate），dtype 为 fp32/bf16/fp16。
pre_idx（时间提示，GVR 必需）：上一步的 top-K，构造为高斯噪声 + 一个二分搜索系数，对每个 K / dtype / N 校准到统一实现命中率 0.6（synth_data.TARGET_HR=0.6，覆盖每个 skill 的 per-cfg 默认值）。传播方式取决于 compress_ratio：K=512/1024 为纵向（cr=4 —— 调用方存 prev_topk，kernel 偏移 0），K=2048 为对角（cr=1 —— 调用方存 prev_topk−1，kernel preIdxOffset=+1 ⇒ 净读取 = prev_topk）。radix 算子忽略 pre_idx，通过逐位直方图选择达到精确 top-K；GVR 同样返回精确 top-K，仅用 pre_idx 为其阈值搜索提供种子。
compress_ratio 约定：radix_cutedsl 取 seq_lens=N；其余算子取 seq_lens=N×cr（kernel 重新计算 N=kv_len/cr）。
确定性：每个 (K, dtype, N) 固定 seed=42 —— 完全可复现；N 网格 4K..256K（仅 N>2K 的 cell）。每台机器使用相同 bundle，故 B300/B200 对比仅隔离硬件。

Input logit distribution — CCDF of the benchmarked data输入 logit 分布 —— 被测数据的 CCDF

CCDF P[ logit ≥ x ] of the actual logit arrays fed to every operator (harness/synth_data.get_bundle, beta_moderate, N=65536, fp32). The marginal logit distribution is N-invariant, so one representative N captures it; bf16/fp16 only quantise these values, not reshape them. Left: full-range CCDF (linear) — the overall beta_moderate shape per generator. Right: the same CCDF on a log y-axis, exposing the rare upper tail that top-K actually selects; each dot marks the top-K selection boundary (the K-th largest logit, at CCDF=K/N) — the operators keep everything to its right. The three generators (V4-Flash K=512, V4-Pro K=1024, V3.2 K=2048) differ in their fitted moderate-bucket Beta, so the curves are distinct but all heavy-left (most mass at low logits).

Regenerate: python report/gen_input_ccdf.py → report/input_ccdf.svg + input_ccdf.csv (decimated curve data).

喂给每个算子的真实 logit 数组的 CCDF P[ logit ≥ x ]（harness/synth_data.get_bundle，beta_moderate，N=65536，fp32）。边缘 logit 分布与 N 无关，故一个代表性 N 即可刻画；bf16/fp16 只量化这些值，不改变形状。左：全量程 CCDF（线性）—— 每个生成器整体的 beta_moderate 形状。右：同一 CCDF 取对数 y 轴，暴露 top-K 实际选中的稀有上尾；每个点标记 top-K 选择边界（第 K 大的 logit，位于 CCDF=K/N）—— 算子保留其右侧的全部。三个生成器（V4-Flash K=512、V4-Pro K=1024、V3.2 K=2048）拟合的 moderate 档 Beta 不同，故曲线各异但都重左（大部分质量在低 logit）。

Deterministic reproduction & SKILL invocation确定性复现与 SKILL 调用

The per-cell logits / pre_idx are generated on-the-fly and held only in RAM during the sweep (not persisted to disk — only the timing JSONL is saved). Generation is fully deterministic, so any cell can be reproduced exactly. Fixed conditions for every cell:

  • seed=42, target_hr=0.6, cfg=beta_moderate (moderate bucket only), BS=1 bundle replicated across rows (no VarLen)
  • dtype ∈ {fp32, bf16, fp16}; N ∈ {4096, 8192, 16384, 32768, 65536, 131072, 262144}, restricted to N > 2·K
  • hit-rate calibration: binary search on the pre_idx Gaussian-noise coefficient, calib_iters=20, calib_tol=0.005, max_c=5.0 (defaults)
  • K=512 → compress_ratio=4 (vertical); K=1024 → compress_ratio=4 (vertical); K=2048 → compress_ratio=1 (diagonal, V3.2 generator is fp32-only, logits cast to dtype afterwards)

(a) Exact call used by the harness (harness/synth_data.py:get_bundle → each skill's synthesize()):

# K=512 (V4 Flash)
from synth_temporal_data import synthesize   # swebench-temporal-synth-v4flash
b = synthesize(N=N, BS=1, cfg_name="beta_moderate", K=512,  compress_ratio=4, seed=42, dtype=DT, target_hr=0.6)

# K=1024 (V4 Pro)
from synth_temporal_data import synthesize   # swebench-temporal-synth-v4pro
b = synthesize(N=N, BS=1, cfg_name="beta_moderate", K=1024, compress_ratio=4, seed=42, dtype=DT, target_hr=0.6)

# K=2048 (true V3.2, cr=1) — generator is fp32-only; cast logits afterwards
from synth_temporal_data import synthesize   # swebench-temporal-synth
b = synthesize(N=N, BS=1, cfg_name="beta_moderate", K=2048, seed=42, target_hr=0.6)
b["logits"] = b["logits"].to(DT)

(b) Equivalent standalone SKILL CLI (writes logits.pt / preIdx.pt / seq_lens.pt + meta.json to --outdir; DT ∈ {fp32,bf16,fp16}, N from the grid above):

# K=512  (V4 Flash)
python .claude/skills/swebench-temporal-synth-v4flash/src/synth_temporal_data.py \
    --K 512  --compress_ratio 4 --N <N> --cfg beta_moderate --target_hr 0.6 \
    --seed 42 --bs 1 --dtype <DT> --outdir <dir>

# K=1024 (V4 Pro)
python .claude/skills/swebench-temporal-synth-v4pro/src/synth_temporal_data.py \
    --K 1024 --compress_ratio 4 --N <N> --cfg beta_moderate --target_hr 0.6 \
    --seed 42 --bs 1 --dtype <DT> --outdir <dir>

# K=2048 (true V3.2, cr=1, fp32-only)
python .claude/skills/swebench-temporal-synth/src/synth_temporal_data.py \
    --K 2048 --N <N> --cfg beta_moderate --target_hr 0.6 --seed 42 --bs 1 --outdir <dir>

(c) Natural-language SKILL prompt (what triggers each generator skill in Claude Code):

“Use the swebench-temporal-synth-v4{flash|pro} skill (or swebench-temporal-synth for K=2048) to generate V4 {Flash K=512 | Pro K=1024 | V3.2 K=2048} indexer top-K synthetic data: cfg=beta_moderate, target_hr=0.6, seed=42, compress_ratio=4 (K=2048 → cr=1), BS=1, dtype in {fp32,bf16,fp16}, for each N in {4K,8K,16K,32K,64K,128K,256K} with N>2·K. Emit logits, preIdx, seq_lens + meta.json (report the realised kernel_side_hit_rate and calibrated_noise_c).”

Generator sources are committed under .claude/skills/<skill>/src/synth_temporal_data.py; the unified target_hr=0.6 override lives in harness/synth_data.py:TARGET_HR. See report/PREIDX_SEMANTICS.md for the vertical/diagonal pre_idx contract.

每个 cell 的 logits / pre_idx 在 sweep 过程中即时生成、仅驻留 RAM（不落盘 —— 只保存计时 JSONL）。生成完全确定，故任意 cell 都可精确复现。每个 cell 的固定条件：

  • seed=42，target_hr=0.6，cfg=beta_moderate（仅 moderate 档），BS=1 bundle 跨行复制（无 VarLen）
  • dtype ∈ {fp32, bf16, fp16}；N ∈ {4096, 8192, 16384, 32768, 65536, 131072, 262144}，限制为 N > 2·K
  • 命中率校准：对 pre_idx 高斯噪声系数做二分搜索，calib_iters=20，calib_tol=0.005，max_c=5.0（默认值）
  • K=512 → compress_ratio=4（纵向）；K=1024 → compress_ratio=4（纵向）；K=2048 → compress_ratio=1（对角，V3.2 生成器仅 fp32，logits 之后再转 dtype）
